code.module:
# The photo frame: photos from /sd/photos, one every few seconds in a random order with no
# repeats; a swipe goes to the next or the previous one, a touch shows the time and Options. At
# night the display goes off, and a touch turns it on for a minute.
#
# The photos are LVGL images in RGB565 at the size of the display (convert_photos.py on the PC
# makes them): 12 bytes of header, then the pixels, drawn with no decoder. Two buffers take turns,
# so the photo on the screen is never the one being read from the card.
#
# The time comes from the network (NTP) through the networks of the Settings example, and is
# Italian time: CET, and CEST from the last Sunday of March to the last Sunday of October.
#
# Add photos, in Options, starts a small web server (photo_web) and shows a QR code: a phone on
# the same WiFi opens the page, chooses photos, and the page itself fits them to the display and
# sends them ready, so nothing has to be installed. A PIN shown on the screen keeps the others of
# the network out. The server stops with Done.
import os
import time

import lvgl as lv

import cac_settings


# --- English and Italian, with the language chosen in the Settings app --------------------
IT = {
    'No photos in /sd/photos.\n\nIn Options, touch Add photos and send them from a phone.': 'Nessuna foto in /sd/photos.\n\nIn Opzioni tocca Aggiungi foto e mandale da un telefono.',
    '--:--': '--:--',
    'Options': 'Opzioni',
    'beach  1/12': 'mare  1/12',
    'Photo Frame': 'Cornice',
    'Cancel': 'Annulla',
    'Save': 'Salva',
    'Next photo every': 'Foto successiva ogni',
    '5 s\n10 s\n30 s\n1 min\n5 min': '5 s\n10 s\n30 s\n1 min\n5 min',
    'Display off at night': 'Schermo spento di notte',
    'From': 'Dalle',
    'To': 'Alle',
    'Swipe left or right for the next or the previous photo; a touch shows the time and this button. At night a touch turns the display on for a minute. The time comes from the network, in Italian time.': "Scorri a sinistra o a destra per la foto successiva o precedente; un tocco mostra l'ora e questo tasto. Di notte un tocco accende lo schermo per un minuto. L'ora viene dalla rete, in ora italiana.",
    'Add photos': 'Aggiungi foto',
    'Done': 'Fine',
    'Connecting to the WiFi...': 'Mi connetto al WiFi...',
    'Scan the code with a phone on the same WiFi, then choose the photos. Keep this page open while they are sent.': 'Inquadra il codice con un telefono sulla stessa WiFi, poi scegli le foto. Tieni aperta questa pagina mentre arrivano.',
    'Demo sunrise': 'Demo alba',
    'Demo sea': 'Demo mare',
    'Demo forest': 'Demo bosco',
    'No WiFi: add your network in the Settings app': "Niente WiFi: aggiungi la tua rete nell'app Settings",
    'The server did not start: %r': "Il server non e' partito: %r",
    'Scan the code, or open the address and type the PIN': "Inquadra il codice, oppure apri l'indirizzo e scrivi il PIN",
    '%d photo received. Keep this page open while the others are sent.': '%d foto arrivata. Tieni aperta questa pagina mentre arrivano le altre.',
    '%d photos received. Keep this page open while the others are sent.': '%d foto arrivate. Tieni aperta questa pagina mentre arrivano le altre.',
}
t = cac_settings.translator(IT)    # t("English text"): the text in the language of the board
_translated = False


def translate_once():
    """The texts of the pages, written in English in the designer, in the language of the board."""
    global _translated
    if not _translated:
        _translated = True
        cac_settings.translate(ui, IT)

import photo_web

try:
    import network  # noqa: F401  only a board has it: the simulator shows demo photos
    import machine
    import display_driver

    HARDWARE = True
except ImportError:
    HARDWARE = False

PHOTOS = "/sd/photos"
SD_PINS = {"slot": 2, "sck": 48, "miso": 41, "mosi": 47, "cs": 42, "freq": 10000000}   # ESP32-4848S040
HEADER = 12
MAGIC = 0x19
INTERVALS = (5, 10, 30, 60, 300)
DEFAULTS = {"interval": 10, "night": True, "night_from": 22 * 60, "night_to": 5 * 60 + 30}
WAKE_MS = 60000
OVERLAY_MS = 5000
SYNC_S = 6 * 3600
SYNCED_YEAR = 2025                 # a clock before this was never set from the network

settings = dict(DEFAULTS)
files = []                         # the photos of the folder
order = []                         # their order for this round
position = -1
buffers = []
slot = 0
shown = None                       # (image descriptor, name) on the screen
photo = None                       # the lv.image, made again with the page
next_at = 0
wake_until = 0
overlay_until = 0
last_gesture = -10000
dark = False
synced = False
last_sync = None
job = None
started = False
web = None                         # the server of Add photos, while its page is open
qr = None
UPLOAD_PORT = 80 if HARDWARE else 8080


def now_ms():
    return time.ticks_ms()


# --- time: Italian time from UTC -----------------------------------------------------------

def _last_sunday(year, month):
    """01:00 UTC of the last Sunday of the month, when Europe changes the clocks."""
    day = 31 if month in (3, 10) else 30
    t = time.mktime((year, month, day, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0))
    weekday = time.gmtime(t)[6]                 # Monday is 0
    return t - ((weekday + 1) % 7) * 86400


def italy_offset(t):
    year = time.gmtime(t)[0]
    return 7200 if _last_sunday(year, 3) <= t < _last_sunday(year, 10) else 3600


def local_time():
    """(hour, minute) in Italy, or None while the clock was never set."""
    t = time.time()
    if time.gmtime(t)[0] < SYNCED_YEAR:
        return None
    local = time.gmtime(t + italy_offset(t))
    return local[3], local[4]


def sync_clock():
    global synced, last_sync
    if not HARDWARE:
        synced = True
    elif cac_settings.connect() is None:
        print("frame: no saved WiFi network in range: no time, no night")
    else:
        try:
            import ntptime

            ntptime.settime()
            synced = True
            print("frame: clock set,", "%02d:%02d" % local_time())
        except Exception as error:
            print("frame: NTP:", repr(error))
    last_sync = time.time()             # after settime(): before it the clock may be in 2000


def is_night():
    if not settings["night"]:
        return False
    now = local_time()
    if now is None:
        return False
    minutes = now[0] * 60 + now[1]
    start, end = settings["night_from"], settings["night_to"]
    if start <= end:
        return start <= minutes < end
    return minutes >= start or minutes < end


# --- photos ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _mount_sd():
    if not HARDWARE:
        return
    try:
        if "sd" not in os.listdir("/") or not os.listdir("/sd"):
            os.mount(machine.SDCard(**SD_PINS), "/sd")
    except Exception as error:
        print("frame: SD card:", repr(error))


def _scan():
    global files
    if not HARDWARE:
        files = [t("Demo sunrise"), t("Demo sea"), t("Demo forest")]
        return
    try:
        files = sorted(n for n in os.listdir(PHOTOS) if n.lower().endswith(".bin"))
    except OSError:
        files = []


def _shuffle():
    global order, position
    _scan()
    order = list(range(len(files)))
    for i in range(len(order) - 1, 0, -1):     # MicroPython's random has no shuffle
        j = _random(i + 1)
        order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
    position = -1


def _random(n):
    try:
        import random

        return random.randrange(n)
    except (ImportError, AttributeError):
        return int.from_bytes(os.urandom(4), "little") % n


def _demo(index, buf, width, height):
    """A gradient for the simulator, one color pair for each demo photo."""
    pairs = ((0x1E5799, 0xF2A541), (0x0B486B, 0x3B8686), (0x1D4D2B, 0x9BC53D))
    top, bottom = pairs[index % len(pairs)]
    view = memoryview(buf)
    row_bytes = width * 2
    for y in range(height):
        mix = y * 255 // max(1, height - 1)
        r = ((top >> 16) * (255 - mix) + (bottom >> 16) * mix) // 255
        g = (((top >> 8) & 255) * (255 - mix) + ((bottom >> 8) & 255) * mix) // 255
        b = ((top & 255) * (255 - mix) + (bottom & 255) * mix) // 255
        value = ((r >> 3) << 11) | ((g >> 2) << 5) | (b >> 3)
        view[y * row_bytes:(y + 1) * row_bytes] = bytes((value & 255, value >> 8)) * width


def _load(index):
    """Read photo index into the free buffer; returns its image descriptor, or None."""
    global slot
    width, height = lv.screen_active().get_width(), lv.screen_active().get_height()
    if not buffers:
        buffers.extend((bytearray(width * height * 2), bytearray(width * height * 2)))
    slot = 1 - slot
    buf = buffers[slot]
    if not HARDWARE:
        _demo(index, buf, width, height)
        w, h = width, height
    else:
        try:
            with open(PHOTOS + "/" + files[index], "rb") as f:
                head = f.read(HEADER)
                if len(head) < HEADER or head[0] != MAGIC:
                    raise ValueError("not an LVGL image")
                w = head[4] | head[5] << 8
                h = head[6] | head[7] << 8
                if w * h * 2 > len(buf):
                    raise ValueError("larger than the display: %dx%d" % (w, h))
                f.readinto(memoryview(buf)[:w * h * 2])
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            print("frame:", files[index], repr(error))
            return None
    if hasattr(lv, "image_cache_drop"):
        lv.image_cache_drop(None)               # the buffer is the same, the pixels are not
    return lv.image_dsc_t({"header": {"magic": lv.IMAGE_HEADER_MAGIC, "cf": lv.COLOR_FORMAT.RGB565,
                                      "w": w, "h": h, "stride": w * 2},
                           "data_size": w * h * 2, "data": buf})


def _show(dsc, name):
    global shown
    shown = (dsc, name)
    photo.set_src(dsc)
    photo.center()
    label = name[:-4] if name.lower().endswith(".bin") else name
    ui.caption.set_text("%s   %d/%d" % (label, position + 1, len(order)))


def step(direction):
    """The next (1) or the previous (-1) photo; a new round, shuffled again, after the last."""
    global position, next_at
    next_at = time.ticks_add(now_ms(), settings["interval"] * 1000)
    if not order or (direction > 0 and position + 1 >= len(order)):
        _shuffle()
    if not order:
        ui.empty.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        return
    ui.empty.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    for _ in range(len(order)):                 # skip the files that cannot be read
        position = (position + direction) % len(order)
        dsc = _load(order[position])
        if dsc is not None:
            _show(dsc, files[order[position]])
            return


# --- the screen ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _backlight(level):
    if HARDWARE and hasattr(display_driver, "backlight"):
        display_driver.backlight(level)


def set_dark(on):
    global dark
    if on == dark:
        return
    dark = on
    if on:
        ui.night_cover.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        _backlight(0)
    else:
        ui.night_cover.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        _backlight(cac_settings.section("display").get("brightness", 70))


def show_overlay():
    global overlay_until
    overlay_until = time.ticks_add(now_ms(), OVERLAY_MS)
    ui.top_bar.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    ui.caption.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    _show_clock()


def _hide_overlay():
    ui.top_bar.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    ui.caption.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)


def _show_clock():
    now = local_time()
    ui.clock.set_text("%02d:%02d" % now if now else "--:--")


def touched():
    """A tap: at night it turns the display on for a minute; by day it shows the time."""
    global wake_until
    if time.ticks_diff(now_ms(), last_gesture) < 400:   # the end of a swipe is not a tap
        return
    if dark:
        wake_until = time.ticks_add(now_ms(), WAKE_MS)
        set_dark(False)
    show_overlay()


def gesture():
    global last_gesture
    last_gesture = now_ms()
    direction = lv.indev_active().get_gesture_dir()
    if dark:
        touched()
    elif direction == lv.DIR.LEFT:
        step(1)
    elif direction == lv.DIR.RIGHT:
        step(-1)


def tick():
    global job
    if job == "upload":
        job = None
        start_upload()
        return
    if web is not None:
        web.poll(15)
        ui.up_hint.set_text(upload_count())
        return
    if not started:
        return
    now = now_ms()
    if job == "sync" or (last_sync is not None and time.time() - last_sync > SYNC_S):
        job = None
        sync_clock()
        return
    awake = time.ticks_diff(wake_until, now) > 0
    set_dark(is_night() and not awake)
    if dark:
        return
    if time.ticks_diff(now, next_at) >= 0:
        step(1)
    if not ui.top_bar.has_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN):
        if time.ticks_diff(now, overlay_until) >= 0:
            _hide_overlay()
        else:
            _show_clock()


def start():
    """The Frame page, at the start and back from Options: the page is made again each time."""
    global photo, started, job, dark
    screen = lv.screen_active()
    screen.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x000000), 0)
    screen.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    photo = lv.image(screen)
    photo.move_background()
    photo.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
    screen.add_event_cb(lambda e: touched(), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)   # a page has no such events
    screen.add_event_cb(lambda e: gesture(), lv.EVENT.GESTURE, None)   # in the designer
    ui.top_bar.set_style_bg_opa(150, 0)
    dark = False
    ui.night_cover.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)   # a touch at night reaches the screen
    ui.night_cover.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    _hide_overlay()
    if not started:
        started = True
        _mount_sd()
        settings.update(cac_settings.section("frame"))
        job = "sync"                            # on the next tick: the screen comes first
        step(1)
    elif shown:
        _show(*shown)
    else:
        step(1)


# --- Options ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def open_options():
    interval = settings["interval"]
    ui.sel_interval.set_selected(INTERVALS.index(interval) if interval in INTERVALS else 1)
    if settings["night"]:
        ui.sel_night.add_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    else:
        ui.sel_night.remove_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    ui.sel_from_hour.set_selected(settings["night_from"] // 60)
    ui.sel_from_min.set_selected(settings["night_from"] % 60 // 15)
    ui.sel_to_hour.set_selected(settings["night_to"] // 60)
    ui.sel_to_min.set_selected(settings["night_to"] % 60 // 15)


def save_options():
    settings["interval"] = INTERVALS[ui.sel_interval.get_selected()]
    settings["night"] = ui.sel_night.has_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    settings["night_from"] = ui.sel_from_hour.get_selected() * 60 + ui.sel_from_min.get_selected() * 15
    settings["night_to"] = ui.sel_to_hour.get_selected() * 60 + ui.sel_to_min.get_selected() * 15
    try:
        cac_settings.set_section("frame", dict(settings))
    except OSError as error:
        print("frame: options not saved:", repr(error))
    ui.load_page(ui.PAGE_FRAME)


# --- Add photos ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def open_upload():
    """The page shows first; the WiFi and the server start on the next tick, which then comes often."""
    global job
    ui.up_status.set_text(t("Connecting to the WiFi..."))
    ui.up_address.set_text("")
    ui.up_pin.set_text("")
    ui.tick.set_period(20)
    job = "upload"


def board_address():
    if not HARDWARE:
        return "127.0.0.1"
    import network

    return network.WLAN(network.STA_IF).ifconfig()[0]


def start_upload():
    global web, qr
    if HARDWARE and cac_settings.connect() is None:
        ui.up_status.set_text(t("No WiFi: add your network in the Settings app"))
        return
    pin = "%04d" % _random(10000)
    language = cac_settings.language()
    web = photo_web.Server(folder=PHOTOS if HARDWARE else "photos", pin=pin, port=UPLOAD_PORT, language=language, note=lambda text: print("frame:", text))
    try:
        web.start()
    except OSError as error:
        web = None
        ui.up_status.set_text(t("The server did not start: %r") % error)
        return
    address = board_address() + ("" if UPLOAD_PORT == 80 else ":%d" % UPLOAD_PORT)
    url = "http://%s/?pin=%s" % (address, pin)
    if qr is None:
        qr = lv.qrcode(lv.screen_active())
        qr.set_size(220)
        qr.set_dark_color(lv.color_hex(0x000000))
        qr.set_light_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF))
        qr.set_style_border_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF), 0)
        qr.set_style_border_width(8, 0)
        qr.set_pos(130, 98)
    qr.update(url, len(url))
    ui.up_status.set_text(t("Scan the code, or open the address and type the PIN"))
    ui.up_address.set_text("http://" + address)
    ui.up_pin.set_text("PIN " + pin)


def upload_count():
    if not web.count:
        return t("Scan the code with a phone on the same WiFi, then choose the photos. Keep this page open while they are sent.")
    return (t("%d photo received. Keep this page open while the others are sent.") if web.count == 1 else t("%d photos received. Keep this page open while the others are sent.")) % web.count


def close_upload():
    """Done: the server stops, and the new photos join from the next photo on."""
    global web, qr, order, shown
    if web is not None:
        web.stop()
        web = None
    qr = None                          # it goes with its page
    ui.tick.set_period(250)
    order = []                         # a new round, with the photos received
    shown = None
    ui.load_page(ui.PAGE_FRAME)
